sourceVideoSpecification.positivePrompt: One continuous twelve-second vertical studio portrait video of Caio Vale, an original fictional Brazilian adult man in his early thirties with medium tan skin, short dark brown textured hair, subtle trimmed stubble and dark brown eyes. He wears a deep teal matte overshirt over a charcoal crew-neck shirt. Locked eye-level medium close-up, natural 50 mm equivalent perspective, stable soft key light and gentle fill, warm-gray matte studio background with subtle depth. He faces the camera silently with an attentive, approachable expression, natural breathing, two subtle blinks and restrained head and eyebrow micro-movements. Photoreal human skin texture, temporally consistent face, hair, clothing and lighting. Single person, single take, no cut, no camera movement.
negativeConstraints: no cut, transition, zoom or camera movement
no hand crossing the mouth, face or neck
no beauty filter, plastic skin or exaggerated expression
no face, hair, wardrobe or background morphing
no lip motion that implies speech

councilDecision.decision: Use one controlled behavioral baseline whose micro-movements remain readable before attempting lip-synced performance.
rejected: multiple source videos because they create identity ambiguity in the first benchmark
dynamic camera and expressive gestures because they conceal temporal face defects
native generated speech because voice must remain on the local provider route
